summary: The first-time experience is smooth overall, with clear lane-switching and jumping tutorials that let the player quickly grasp the core loop. Minor friction occurs on the final Game Over screen, which lacks any prompt or button before transitioning to the end card.

items.title: Game Over screen lacks a prompt or button
items.evidence: At t=24.9s, the GAME OVER screen appears over the frozen highway with no buttons or instructions (46% clarity), and the player's last input had no visible effect before the end card appeared 2 seconds later.
items.suggestion: Add a brief 'Loading results...' indicator or a 'Continue' / 'Tap to continue' prompt on the GAME OVER screen so players know the end card is about to appear rather than thinking the playable froze.

items.title: Abrupt crash transition ignores final swipe
items.evidence: At t=13.4s, the player's last input had no visible effect right as the car hit a pink X block and transitioned to the CRASHED! Revive popup.
items.suggestion: Add a brief hit-stop or impact flash (e.g., 0.2s) before showing the CRASHED! popup so the player clearly registers the collision rather than feeling their last swipe was ignored.

items.title: 2.0s delay before first successful lane switch
items.evidence: The car starts moving immediately at SPD 53 with the 'Swipe to switch lanes!' prompt and hand hint, taking 2.0s before the first input visibly works.
items.suggestion: Allow swipe inputs to register immediately from t=0.0s and consider starting the car slightly slower during the first 1-2 seconds so the first lane switch feels instant.
